text:
ana: Quick standup  final GA readiness items for Adaptive Routing & Cost Controls. Need a tight checklist: SLA, docs (public+internal), oncall/playbook, monitoring/alerts, pricing caps, and rollback rules. Targeting launch next Mon.

kevin: SLA proposal: Hosted Standard 99.9% (p95 <= 180ms), Premium 99.95% (p95 <= 120ms). Degraded-mode SLA when fallback active: 99.0% (30d rolling). I'll draft Confluence section.

priya: Oncall/playbook: I can own. Alerts I want: fallback_rate > 4% for 10m -> P1, error_rate > 1.5% for 10m -> P0 + auto-rollback. I'll add runbook steps, mitigation, and an escalation path.

sara: Docs: I'll publish the public FAQ + quickstart (operational-playbook). Kevin -> internal runbook & migration guide. Priya -> oncall doc. Miguel -> pricing blurb review.

miguel: Pricing/finops: recommend initial burst cap 500k tokens/day for new accounts; finops template exists. Need eng cost delta for pricing page by Thu.

kevin: Eng cost delta: expect ~15-22% unit savings with caching + adaptive batching for chat workloads. Will attach microbench to the PR by Thu.

priya: Preflight smoke for CI gate (snippet):
`curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":8}' https://api.redwood/v1/generate`
Assert 200, body contains "choices", latency < 450ms. I'll wire into pipeline.

ana: Rollout plan: canary 2% 6h -> 10% 12h (manual go/no-go) -> 30% 12h -> full. Auto-fallback to baseline if error_rate > 2% for 15m or fallback_rate > 12% for 5m.

sara: Announcement copy: I'll draft a one-paragraph blurb noting availability across Hosted/Dedicated/Private and SLA differences. Miguel will confirm pricing lines.

ops-bot: Reminder: Oncall rota next Mon 09:00 UTC  Priya primary for first 72h post-launch.

miguel: Finops note: we'll enable bill-protection suspend if usage >2x baseline for 48h; Sales must approve lift. I'll add wording to pricing doc.

kevin: Runbook PR + SLA draft posted today.

sara: Public docs draft ready Fri morning for review.

priya: CI smoke integrated by Fri midday; will post pipeline link.

ana: Blockers: (1) SLA doc in Confluence, (2) runbook PR merged, (3) pricing + caps merged, (4) CI smoke green. Owners: kevin, kevin, miguel, priya. Can we close by Fri EOD?

kevin: Yes, will finish SLA + runbook edits today.

miguel: Pricing PR in review Thu.

sara: Announcement queued for PM review Fri AM.

priya: Smoke test and oncall playbook will be done by Fri EOD.

ana: Great. If all green we schedule the 2% canary Mon 02:00 UTC. If anything slips flag here and we'll decide scope vs date. Thanks.
